releaseRule: FINAL_APP_READY requires certified runtime stability, modular six-destination ownership, real-data phone acceptance, certified Mass product parity, and exact recovery of the approved non-Mass donor presentation chain. Feature presence or conceptual equivalence is insufficient.
requiredPhoneJourney: cold launch -> Home -> Calendar -> Mass selection -> native LIVE -> Settings overlay/restore -> leave/resume -> PRAY -> Home -> Learn -> Home -> Learn -> PRAY/Calendar/Settings

findings.detail: R17 native Mass is a certified subsystem and is not an app-convergence blocker.
The complete certified special-structure scope has actual-index phone-Chromium evidence.
The Prayer Book aria-hidden/focused-descendant regression is explicitly exercised without Chromium blocked-aria-hidden warnings.

D3-D6 behavioral convergence is enforced on modular production owners: D3-D5 remain integrated with modular PRAY, while D6 Sources/About and canonical app-version ownership are native to AO_SETTINGS_APP_V1. Session-only exposition state, bounded Adoration/Benediction behavior, read-only Confession examination with five canonical phases, and reader-facing Sources/About remain regression-covered.
AO_APP_SHELL_V1 adopts the production six-destination ribbon, strips legacy ribbon click ownership, and owns visible navigation state while preserving donor-backed destination rendering.

Actual index.html passes the required phone/touch journey from cold Home through Calendar and native LIVE, including Settings opened over the same active R17 session with structural locks and same-reader restoration, interrupted reload at an active Mass, exact-section resume, cancelled and confirmed leave, PRAY, Home, Learn and Settings, with zero legacy Mass starts.

The modular app shell owns active-Mass ribbon suppression, forced haptics-off, structural-setting lockout, and focus-safe hiding. AO_SETTINGS_APP_V1 consumes this single guard while overlaying an active native reader; opening/closing Settings neither suspends nor restarts R17.

The embedded v43.33 emergency CSS/JS runtime has been physically removed from production index.html. Required live-session behavior is owned by src/app/live-session-guards.js and remains covered by the actual-index phone journey.

Production index.html contains exactly one Mass browser-entry module include. The obsolete inline icon bridge is removed; the modular Mass browser entry resolves the host icon bank directly, and production-tree hygiene regression-locks both invariants.

Calendar, Home, PRAY, Learn and Settings presentation ownership are extracted and actual-index phone-certified. Home now owns its base presentation plus Coming Up and Daily Catechism through src/home, continuously retires asynchronously reinserted donor Home cards, and uses canonical V4/V4.1.1 asset identities. Settings runs through AO_SETTINGS_APP_V1 with Sources/About and active-R17 overlay safety. Normal production no longer depends on historical Settings fallbacks or donor Home enricher presentation.

Actual-index phone acceptance proves cold state, active-Mass checkpointing, reload without auto-reactivation, explicit resume at the saved section, preservation of form/mode/posture/gesture/language preferences, intentional suspension, and isolation of unrelated local state.

The 5 October P0 runtime regressions are repaired and verified on merged main. Post-merge App convergence run 37276882767 passed the normal phone journey and real-data Oct 4-9 field-current-week acceptance: every date resolved a READY Proper, runtime recovery filled missing Secret/Postcommunion source sections where needed, every R17 reader was ready, and no reader slots remained missing. Stale persisted Mass checkpoints also fail closed without uncaught resume.

The definitive Mass presentation is certified against the executable v1.80 donor on the single native renderer. Static R17, real-touch Mass phone, app-shell phone and donor-derived visual acceptance all passed after current-main integration. The 48-step product remains explicitly non-historical with respect to unrecovered v1.83 card identities.

Presentation FX V1-V5 certifies that cinematic, rail, hero and art-loading mechanisms exist on modular surfaces. It does not certify exact reproduction of the later approved non-Mass prototype composition, trigger semantics, geometry, timings or module choreography; those are governed by EXACT_NON_MASS_DONOR_PARITY.

The reopened v1.80 presentation gate is closed. Real-touch phone acceptance certifies the donor two-axis navigation contract; dedicated visual acceptance certifies full Schola controls and translation lifecycle plus the structured v1.79 Guide; source-rubric and one-state-one-surface checks are locked; and the complete 67-entry v4.6 Mass master bank is exact-donor manifest-certified and runtime-wired.

All currently demonstrated non-Mass implementation defects are repaired and current phone/visual acceptance is green, including restored v43.59.6 Settings, the real v43.12 cinematic runtime, final Adoration composition, Benediction blessing asset, semantic rails, Rosary, Novenas, Traditional PRAY/Learn and Calendar/v38.4. Release remains blocked because exact immutable primary donor evidence for Ad_Orientem_v3_4_14.html and Ad_Orientem_NON_MASS_HEAD_v3_22_NOVENA_FREEZE_CALENDAR_DASHBOARD_C2.html is unavailable; successor lineage is not treated as byte-exact primary evidence.
